test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7c7ee9b499f9f32e0b22835a9369468a4f03d7897715e9128f4af77a978f113.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Alphabet A shifted the left upper side and add +1, then B shifted the left bottom side and add +1, and finally, C shifted the right bottom side and add + 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05988637d0121f986b7c3ecd21b963fb42e660c54e3feab0a0610c6fbe03fdbc.png] 

2) Alphabet Z shifted the right bottom side and subtract -1, then Y shifted the right upper side and subtract - 1, and X finally shifted the right upper side and subtract - 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e08a72c2e7dc31f9a9fcd5e74c901df880d7353dc1be8907df4b88c14a341c5.png] 

3) Middle circle is blank in the first figure, and colored with black colored in the second figure, and again blank circle in the third figure, finally colored with black colored in the final figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddd507aeabafc4eee15896482a3c78064e528131acb5d1f3396b9423ea5c1d3a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
